"title": "Create shared inheritance tracking ledger",
"text": "Create a shared tracking ledger for inherited accounts, estate contacts, forms, ownership notes, and open questions for Nadia Thimblefern to discuss the estate with her brother Rowan.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-02-23",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Nadia asked for a shared tracking ledger for inherited accounts, estate contacts, forms received, ownership notes, and open questions so she can discuss the estate with Rowan using the same record set; they agreed to build it by 2024-02-23."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Upload certified probate authority paperwork",
"text": "Upload the certified authority paperwork for the estate to the secure portal for the custodian and Teacup Comet Bank on behalf of Nadia Thimblefern.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-02-20",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For probate authority documents, the estate attorney has provided death certificate copies, but the certified authority paperwork needed by the custodian and bank has not been uploaded to the secure portal; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-02-20."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Resolve Teacup Comet Bank access issue",
"text": "Coordinate with Teacup Comet Bank to correct the executor record mismatch and restore estate‑account access for Nadia Thimblefern.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-02-16",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Teacup Comet Bank rejected Nadia’s online estate-account access attempt and told her the executor record did not match its internal file, preventing her from viewing recent estate cash activity; the agreed follow-up on the estate bank access problem is due 2024-02-16."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Confirm IRA beneficiary designation",
"text": "Confirm the correct beneficiary percentage for Alden Thimblefern’s IRA by reconciling the paper copy with the custodian portal for Nadia Thimblefern before signing inherited IRA paperwork.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For Alden’s IRA beneficiary percentage, Nadia brought a paper beneficiary copy that does not match the percentage shown in the custodian portal, and the controlling designation needs to be confirmed before inherited IRA paperwork is signed; follow-up is needed, with no date supplied."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Organize estate inventory for CPA",
"text": "Prepare and organize the estate inventory, anticipated income items, and beneficiary distribution details for the CPA and estate attorney for Nadia Thimblefern ahead of the next tax‑planning conversation.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-03-01",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "The estate inventory, anticipated income items, and beneficiary distributions need to be organized for the CPA and estate attorney before the next tax‑planning conversation tied to the estate administration calendar; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-03-01."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Update fiduciary role in estate documents",
"text": "Update the successor fiduciary appointment in the 2016 personal estate documents to reflect Alden Thimblefern’s death for Nadia Thimblefern.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-03-08",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "The planning review found the 2016 personal estate documents’ reference to Alden in a successor fiduciary role creates a stale appointment after his death; the agreed follow-up on the fiduciary role update is due 2024-03-08."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Design separate inherited asset framework",
"text": "Develop a separate investment and spending framework for inherited assets that preserves retirement flexibility, funds college costs, maintains cash reserves, and keeps estate proceeds distinct from routine spending for Nadia Thimblefern.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-03-15",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Nadia wants a separate investment and spending framework for inherited assets that accounts for retirement flexibility, college costs, cash reserves, and her preference not to blend estate proceeds into routine spending immediately; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-03-15."
}
